proposal.name: Include reader charts in verification receipts

plan.name: Include reader charts in verification receipts
plan.summary: Deliver all of #615 in one plumbing change: recompute reader charts for modeled verification, synthesis and factory gate receipts from one snapshot of the actual checked model, sibling TLA+ includes, saved .invariant/view.json, lock and bounded TLC evidence, sharing graph/replay/evaluation and literal-safe Mermaid/report serialization with proposals and using the existing native SVG renderer. Add optional version-1 reader data to verification JSON with a separate sha256 fingerprint binding source bytes, bounds, statements, tools and computed contents, explicit input hashes, and exactly one chart, too_large limitation or unavailable diagnostic; support every ordinary graph through 500 reachable states, keep all says words, hidden occurrences, unavailable actions, counts and bounds, obtain impossible-action claims only from complete exploration, and never let chart generation, rendering or diagnostics change Passed, assurance, verification fingerprints, locks or proposal identities. Preserve the saved view and sibling includes from the original project through synthesis preparation and assembly, discard agent-supplied derived reader artifacts, compute again after model edits, and use one receipt writer for verify -out and synthesis/factory gate directories to save receipt.json, receipt.md, reader.json and reader.svg (SVG only for a drawable chart), removing obsolete reader files on directory reuse and retaining ordinary output errors; these files travel in the existing whole-directory CI archives without workflow changes. Missing views and old reports remain readable with an explicit no-reader-chart explanation, malformed views and graph/replay/render failures retain useful separate diagnostics without invented or partial charts, plumbing remains chart-free, and the only intentional change to legacy Markdown is that explanation, updating the four named golden-test files while keeping their existing verification fingerprint expectations and other assertions. Update SPEC.md with existing supporting decision citations, the README's short linked description, docs/statecharts.md and docs/gate.md for the delivered formats, provenance, offline SVG, limits and assurance boundary; the merger records the new receipt policy decision because this plumbing build cannot write decisions/.

tests.name: TestReader615VerifiedChart
tests.says: Verification computes a complete chart from checked source and the saved view, with exact rules, hidden steps, impossible actions, counts, bounds and tool/source provenance, without changing assurance or its fingerprint.

tests.name: TestReader615RecomputesChangedInputs
tests.says: Model, include and view edits invalidate reader identity and recompute actual topology; saved proposal artifacts never substitute for the final model.

tests.name: TestReader615CapacityAndDiagnostics
tests.says: 500 states still produce a complete chart, 501 produce an explicit size report, and malformed views or failed graph or replay generation remain separate diagnostics with the gate verdict intact.

tests.name: TestReader615SynthesisAndFactory
tests.says: Both synthesis and the factory's production build path retain project reader inputs and archive JSON, Mermaid and standalone SVG for the final changed model.

tests.name: TestReader615MissingViewAndSnapshot
tests.says: Missing or unsafe views cannot invent a chart, and mutation of original inputs during a check cannot mix source generations in a receipt.

tests.name: TestReader615ReceiptRoundTrip
tests.says: Reader JSON round trips without loss, Markdown retains literal Mermaid, rules and report details, and rendering neither mutates evidence nor upgrades a failed verdict.

tests.name: TestReader615LegacyReceipt
tests.says: Legacy reports remain decodable with their old evidence fingerprint and explicitly say no reader chart is available until a view is supplied.

tests.name: TestReader615VerifyCLIArtifacts
tests.says: The verify command writes consistent receipt and reader JSON, Markdown and offline SVG into the archived output tree, clears stale SVGs on reuse and preserves exit status and output errors.

tests.name: TestReader615FactoryReceiptAndPlumbing
tests.says: Factory pull request receipts show the final gate's reader rather than a proposal's chart, while plumbing receipts stay chart-free and failed gates stay failed.
